comment: datestr multi-date input (covers datestr; separate from datestr.json for the VM 255-register limit). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: numkit threw 'multi-date matrix input not yet supported' AND the numel==6 check mis-treated a 6x1 column as a single date vector. MATLAB R2025b rule: an N-by-6 matrix (cols==6) is N DATE VECTORS (one row each); anything else is serial date NUMBERS in column-major order (numel rows). datestr([738885;738886;738900]) -> 3x11 char matrix; a row vector also becomes N rows; with a format the width follows the format; a 2x6 matrix -> 2 date vectors ('01-Jan-2020 00:00:00'/'15-Jun-2021 12:30:00'); a 6x1 column -> 6 dates (c6r=6). Cross-engine fingerprint via shapes + sum(char codes).
